summary.text: Jessica Arriaga, a Republican healthcare professional from North Philadelphia, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Pennsylvania's 2nd District to Brendan Boyle.
Her campaign says she has worked in operating rooms for more than 20 years and describes herself as a mother.

paragraphs.text: According to her campaign website, Arriaga was born and raised in North Philadelphia and is a mother.
She has worked in operating rooms as a healthcare professional for more than 20 years and says she has also helped families in her community find healthcare, resources and opportunity.
She describes herself as "not a career politician" and says she is not backed by political insiders.
Arriaga advanced from the May 19, 2026 Republican primary with 100% of 6,328 votes, with no other candidate on the ballot.
During the campaign she ran on a message of results-focused leadership for Philadelphia families.
She received 19.2% of the vote to Brendan Boyle's 80.8%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
